E4.embedding: lesson (when, do, avoid) + symptom, pinned E5, query prefix
E4.criterion: cosine silhouette on the held-out split; ties -> the smaller threshold
E4.revision: attempt 1 (raw E5 vectors, no centring) chose 0.14: on the held-out split the silhouette peaked at k=2 (one outlier vs the rest) and the full set merged 96 of 101 episodes into one cluster. Revised ONCE, before any pre-registration or arm output: mean-centred vectors (E5 anisotropy) with the grid widened to 0.10-1.50 (centred cosine distances span 0-2), same split and criterion, plus a guard that refuses packets when one cluster holds > 50% of the episodes.

rules.split: stricter label of readers A and B (correct/grounded/useful need both true; harmful/overgeneralized count when either is true); reader C (split units only) is reported, never used for the bar
rules.grounded: the deterministic E4 check (every quote inside ONE evidence quote of the cited episode; group count, recurrence count and first/last seen recomputed by code from the cited episodes; a cross-project lesson cites >= 2 independence groups) AND both readers' grounded label
rules.packet_types: cross-project and project-local units are pooled for the bars; each type is also reported per arm
rules.abstain: a packet answered with 'no lesson' gives no unit; abstentions are reported per run
rules.gemini_runs: pooled over both runs; each run also reported
rules.failed_output: a packet without a schema-valid output after the provider's retry counts as an arm failure, reported, no units
rules.no_units: an arm with 0 gradeable units cannot be GO
rules.verdict: GO-Gemini when Gemini passes every bar and Opus is at most opus_margin_max better on each margin metric; GO-Opus-only (owner call) when only Opus passes the absolute bars; else NO-GO
